candidates.change_summary: Move the final delete of the caller's pendingFlashDecision entry from after the IERC20 transfer to before it, matching the pre-call state deletion behavior.
Replace the amount check > 0 with a non-zero asset check upon withdrawal.
Change the unlock time comparison from < block.timestamp to <= block.timestamp, allowing withdrawal exactly at unlock time.
Delete the final statement that clears the caller's pending flash governance decision after the successful transfer.
Weaken nothing in the require? Actually replace the require condition's amount check from > 0 to >= 0, allowing zero-amount withdrawals that have a matching asset and expired unlock time.
Replace the unlockTime expiry check from < block.timestamp to <= block.timestamp, allowing withdrawal exactly at the unlock timestamp.
Move the delete of the pending decision from after the external token transfer to before it, so the callee observes the state cleared during the external call.
Replace the token source of the withdrawal transfer with the asset parameter instead of the stored pending decision asset, changing behavior when they differ.
Replace the assignment `configured = true` with `configured = false` in `endConfiguration`.
Replace the setDAO guard with `require(true, "EK")`, allowing DAO to be overwritten in all cases.
Delete the guard requiring that the caller be authorized to change the DAO.
Replace the DAO assignment with a no-op, so setDAO never changes DAO.
Replace the DAO assignment with assignment to itself, so setDAO leaves DAO unchanged.
Remove the DAO initialization guard require, allowing setDAO to run even when the caller is unauthorized and the contract is configured.
Replace the DAO initialization guard's strict configured condition with an always-false condition, removing the configured-state restriction from the authorization check.
Remove the assignment that updates the stored DAO address, so setDAO no longer changes the DAO state variable.
Remove the deletion of the cached governer address, so setDAO leaves the old governer in place.
